text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Winning Ticket
to the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh~...
It's... it's totally hopeless nowww~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told me that with this injury,
even all my power won't heal it right away...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh!! No, no, nooo~!!
I wanna go bag to drayning alreadyyy~!!
choice_data_list: Don't rush—let's heal up nice and slow.
Then let's push beyond our absolute limits!!
Then let's push beyond the limits of our full power!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh!! No, no, nooo~!!
I wanna go bag to drayning alreadyyy~!!
choice_data_list: Don't rush—let's heal up nice and slow.
Then let's push beyond our absolute limits!!
Then let's push beyond the limits of our full power!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Slow down...? But, but,
then I'll have less time to train...?
choice_data_list: Healing that injury is far more important.
Healing that injury is far more important, you know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Kh—?! Y-You care...!!
That much about me... struck by your words...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Tr-Trainerrr-saaan...!
Thank youuu... Thank you so muuuuch...!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*snort-sniffle*... I-I just...!!
Even though you gave me all your feelings—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I hate that I can't heal my injuries
with max muscle power so muuuuch~!!
Waahhhhhh...!!
That day, I soothed Winning Ticket and made sure she got plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
――Haaah!!!
I'll push past the very limits of my full power...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I see... That's right!
If max power up until now can't fix it—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is get a super-hyper new full-power boost!
And get it right awayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"What should we do to make that happen...!
Hmmm, uhhh... let's see...!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—I know! I gotta get lots and lots of nutrition!
I'll go grab us some food from the school store-—!

Panicking, I stopped Winning Ticket as she almost dashed off
forgetting her injury, and headed to the school store in her place...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I... ate too buch...
By stubach is so stuffed, it hurds~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still... I gotta push through right here...!
With my new all-out power, I'll heal this injury—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...*collapses*
Winning Ticket collapsed and ended up spending some time in the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Aaah!
Thanks for the feast!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My belly's full!! Energy overflowing!!
Brand-new, full-throttle power!! Acquiredーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san!
With this, I'll be able to heal my injury in no time flat!
Winning Ticket regained her spirit, burning with passion for her comeback...!
